title: Theorem 2.6: irreducibility $\Rightarrow$ existence of unitaries $u_1,u_2\in M_1$, $u_3\in M_2$ in free position over $B$

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Location:** Proof of Theorem 2.6, the sentence "Since $\Gamma$ is irreducible, either $M_1$ must contain two unitaries $u_1,u_2$ ... (otherwise ...)".

For the AFP decomposition $M=\Gamma(\mathcal G\setminus\{v\})\ast_{\Gamma(\mathrm{link}(v))}\Gamma(\mathrm{star}(v))$ with $M_1=\Gamma(\mathcal G\setminus\{v\})$, $B=\Gamma(\mathrm{link}(v))$, $M_2=\Gamma(\mathrm{star}(v))$, Lemma 2.5 needs $u_1,u_2\in\mathcal U(M_1)$ and $u_3\in\mathcal U(M_2)$ with $E_B(u_1)=E_B(u_2)=E_B(u_3)=E_B(u_1^*u_2)=0$.

The written case analysis is terse and appears to contain a typo ("$(u,u')\in\mathcal V(\mathcal G)$" should presumably be an edge $(u,u')\in\mathcal E$). It must be made rigorous:
- Construct $u_3$: a trace-zero unitary at vertex $v$ lies in $\mathrm{star}(v)$ but not $\mathrm{link}(v)$, so $E_B(u_3)=0$. (Uses the hypothesis that each $M_w$ has a trace-zero unitary.)
- Construct $u_1,u_2\in M_1$ from trace-zero vertex unitaries at vertices outside $\mathrm{star}(v)$; the conditions $E_B(u_1)=E_B(u_2)=E_B(u_1^*u_2)=0$ require either two **non-adjacent** such vertices (free independence) or careful handling when only one vertex lies outside $\mathrm{star}(v)$.
- Show the "only one vertex outside $\mathrm{star}(v)$" + "that vertex adjacent to ..." sub-case contradicts irreducibility (using $|\mathcal V|\ge3$).

Each branch must be tied precisely to the stated definition of irreducibility.

comments.author: solver-agent
comments.body:
I reviewed the current `solution.tex`. The proof of Theorem 2.6 ("Proof of the main theorem") already contains a fully rewritten, rigorous case analysis replacing the terse/typo'd original sentence. I verified each branch, ran combinatorial checks on the graph-product reduced-word normal form, and tightened two spots. All three points in the issue are addressed and tied precisely to the stated definition of irreducibility (both partitions used are disjoint with both parts nonempty).

**u3.** A trace-zero unitary a_v at vertex v lies in star(v) but not link(v); a single letter from M_v^o with v∉link(v) is L^2B-orthogonal, so E_B(u3)=0.

**W := V∖star(v) nonempty.** If W=∅, every vertex ≠v is adjacent to v; the disjoint partition G1={v}, G2=G∖{v} (both nonempty since |V|≥3) makes every cross-pair an edge — reducibility, contradiction.

**Case A (|W|≥2).** Pick distinct w1,w2∈W; u1=a_{w1}, u2=a_{w2}. Since w1≠w2 lie in different vertex algebras they never merge: if (w1,w2)∉E, u1*u2 is a length-2 reduced word; if (w1,w2)∈E they commute and u1*u2=a_{w2}a_{w1}* is still length 2 on two distinct vertices. All letters in W⊆V∖link(v), so E_B(u1*u2)=0. (Verified numerically both subcases stay reduced.)

**Case B (|W|=1, W={w}).** I confirmed there is u'∉{v,w} with (u',w)∉E: else w is adjacent to all u'∉{v,w}, and the disjoint partition G1={v,w}, G2=V∖{v,w}=link(v) (nonempty since |V|≥3 — exactly where |V|≥3 is used) makes every cross-pair an edge, contradicting irreducibility. Take b∈M_{u'} trace-zero (u'∈link(v) so b∈B), set u1=a_w, u2=b·a_w. Then E_B(u1)=0, E_B(u2)=b·E_B(a_w)=0, and crucially E_B(u1*u2)=E_B(a_w* b a_w)=0.

**The decisive reduced-word fact**, which I verified combinatorially in the graph-product normal form: a_w* b a_w stays a length-3 reduced word (w,u',w) precisely because (u',w)∉E (u' does not commute with w, so the two a_w-letters cannot be brought adjacent). It contains a letter at w∉link(v), hence is B-orthogonal. Had u' been adjacent to w it would collapse to b∈B and give E_B=b≠0 — confirming non-adjacency is genuinely necessary.

Edits to solution.tex: (i) Case A — made explicit that distinct vertices w1≠w2 cannot merge regardless of adjacency; (ii) Case B — spelled out why non-adjacency of u' prevents collapse, with the contrasting collapse computation. The four conditions E_B(u1)=E_B(u2)=E_B(u3)=E_B(u1*u2)=0 of Lemma (lem:afp) now hold in every case with full justification.

Gap resolved. (LaTeX toolchain unavailable in sandbox; \begin/\end counts balance and edits are self-contained.)
